name: Age And Wisdom
overview: Scripture reveals that true wisdom and understanding are closely linked with age and experience, as seen in Job's affirmation that wisdom resides with the ancient and that many days teach understanding. The Psalms express a longing to continue demonstrating God's strength even in old age, emphasizing the value of a life lived under the protection and guidance of the Almighty. Proverbs highlights that a hoary head is a crown of glory when accompanied by righteousness, and that the fear of the Lord is foundational to gaining knowledge, contrasting the wise with those who despise instruction. Together, these verses affirm that aging, when marked by reverence for God and righteousness, brings honored wisdom that benefits both the individual and future generations.
